approval_evidence.quote: NDA 210806 ... PIFELTRO (doravirine) tablet in combination with other antiretroviral agents for the treatment of HIV-1 infection in adult patients with no prior antiretroviral treatment history. It is approved, effective on the date of this letter (FDA approval letter, signed 08/30/2018)

series_start_reason: Merck prints Pifeltro on its own sales line only from the first-quarter 2024 earnings release (2024-04-25) and Form 10-Q, which carry the four 2023 quarters as prior-year columns, so the series starts at 2023Q1. Releases, 10-Qs and 10-Ks through the fourth-quarter 2023 release print no Pifeltro sales (the 10-K sections for 2018-2023 mention Pifeltro only in approval, patent and clinical text). The FY2024 10-K prints annual Pifeltro sales for 2022 (118), which cannot be split into quarters.
series_end_reason: The fourth-quarter 2025 release (2026-02-03, accession 0001104659-26-009495) and the FY2025 10-K (2026-02-24) print Pifeltro. The first-quarter 2026 release (2026-04-30), the second-quarter 2026 release (2026-08-04) and the 2026 Forms 10-Q (2026-05-04, 2026-08-07) print Delstrigo, Isentress/Isentress HD and other HIV lines but no Pifeltro line, and no text states Pifeltro was folded into another line.
notes: Worldwide (U.S. plus international) Pifeltro (doravirine alone) sales in USD millions from the Virology rows of Merck's worldwide product sales table in the earnings releases. Delstrigo (doravirine/lamivudine/tenofovir DF) is a separate line and is not included. 2023 quarters come from prior-year columns of the 2024 releases. Quarters sum to the printed annual totals (2023 142, 2024 163, 2025 171).
